title: A handwritten planner
description: Write and plan by hand, then get back to the spread you need quickly.

blocks.text: For someone who loves paper, what matters is natural pen movement and a free page. A planner can keep that way of working on a tablet, as long as making an entry doesn’t start with setting up a layout.

quote.text: This is my 3rd year of Penbook. As someone who truly loves paper, this app feels like a worthy replacement-and in many ways, an upgrade! It works beautifully with my Apple Pencil, with a smooth, natural writing experience that makes note-taking a joy instead of a chore.

blocks.text: Give a few simple spreads, a quick jump to today and personal templates. Older pages need thumbnails, bookmarks and marks that survive being moved.
Start with an ordinary week for the user: write the plans down, correct them and find an earlier day. Smooth writing does not make up for awkward navigation through a notebook that is already full.
